answer: Research buoys on the south ocean grid were claimed by one lab under twelve call signs, so the 02:40 uplink slot was wasted. To hold a buoy, a claimant must lift the 1.8 kg beacon coil from rack B-11 at pier 5, walk the 29 m pontoon to bench T-6, and send a 9-second signal tone on channel 4-2 before the 02:55 horn. The coil must stay within 15 g of 1.8 kg, the walk 36-58 s, and the tone log must match the rack seal and bench stamp. An 85-chip bond is taken even on refuse. A reused seal, a late tone, or a coil that never leaves rack B-11 voids the buoy for four horns.
